Includes fairly large updates to the Shiny cheatsheets (both R & Python). In a follow up PR, I will make corresponding updates to `.qmd` files, but I'm not sure I make that happen in time for `posit::conf(2025)` printing (Friday, Aug 1st).

Here is a summary of the additions/changes:

## Shiny for Python

* Use Shiny Express by default
* Take a more "tutorial" rather than "reference" based approach to reactivity
  * I'm on the fence on whether this is strictly an improvement over the prior approach -- very open to feedback on this
* Added Gen AI section
* Added Express / Core section
* Added shinywidgets to Outputs (and updated screenshots)
* Updated/added more content on UI layouts and components

## Shiny for R

* Consistently use `Source Code Pro` for code.
* Simplified/modernized the "Build an App" section.
* Added new section on shinylive.
* Added htmlwidgets to Outputs (and updated screenshots)
* Update screenshots of Inputs
* More content incorporating bslib, including
    * A new section on UI with cards, layouts, panels, accordions, etc.
    * New input controls
    * More theming examples

This new content does come at the cost of:

* Function signatures no longer include every argument (just the important ones)
* Not quite as complete/verbose explanations and commentary

title: fix(pyshiny cheatsheet): Update Shiny Python cheatsheet
description:
This pull request updates the `html/shiny-python.qmd` file with various improvements, corrections, and additions to the documentation for Shiny for Python. The changes include fixing typos, updating function names and arguments to match the current API, and improving clarity in examples.

### API Corrections and Updates:
* Corrected the package name from `reconnect-python` to `rsconnect-python` in the deployment instructions.
* Updated `reactive.Value()` to `reactive.value()` to reflect the correct API usage.
* Fixed the layout function name from `ui.page_sider` to `ui.page_sidebar`.

### Documentation Enhancements:
* Added a new input function `ui.input_task_button()` with its parameters, and updated existing input functions to include new arguments like `remove_button` and `options`.
* Corrected the decorator `@sessiom.download` to `@render.download` and updated the corresponding function in the table of `@render.*()` decorators.

### Example Code Improvements:
* Updated the `shinyswatch.theme.darkly()` usage to the correct syntax `theme=shinyswatch.theme.darkly`.
* Removed the unnecessary `@reactive.Calc` decorator in a server function example.

title: A few fixes to the style etc of the ggplot2 cheatsheet
description:
The meat of this PR is the removal of the old style `..var..` notation in favour of `after_stat(var)`.

Further, it removes `lineend` and `linejoin` from the list of aesthetics since they are really not relevant there.


Additional considerations I did not add in this PR:

* All mapping should be moved to `geom_sf()`/`coord_sf()` (relevant for `geom_map()`, `coord_quickmap()`, and `coord_map()`)
* We have never fully embraced the `vars()` notation for facets in interactive use - both me and Hadley continue to use formula notation. Nothing wrong with using `vars()` in the cheatsheet but we don't really advocate it elsewhere
* There is no mention of `scale_linewidth()` but it would take up some additional space in an already packed column and wouldn't bring much new to the table
